summary: Story decomposition is sound: two leaves, each a strict subset of the parent's 4 subsystems (WI-03b1: world content data, creature simulation, headless scenario tests; WI-03b2: world content data, procedural creature rendering) and of its 3 criteria, each with one focused behavior and at most 3 changed responsibilities - the tier-2 simulation batch (CreatureDefs plus signature interactions incl. the 2+ friendly floor, per-species headless tests) and the tier-2 production-presence batch (spawns in the designed band, data-driven shapes on the WI-02b pipeline, one spot-check). Per-organism splits are invalid under the accepted WI-03a tier-batch standard, so behavior_count 1 per leaf is consistent with the sibling review. Dependencies correct: WI-03b2 depends on WI-03b1 (spawns reference the defs; the spot-check exercises the friendly interaction); the story has no in-tier dependencies per the ST-03 policy, no ancestor/descendant dependencies; sibling edges WI-03c->[WI-03b] and WI-03d->[WI-03a,WI-03b,WI-03c] verified in their frontmatter. Acceptance preserved: child criteria are verbatim parent text and their union covers all three - AC-roster-count via WI-03b2, AC-roster-behavior via WI-03b1, AC-roster-tests via both. Cross-child proof has named owners matching the ST-03 plan: WI-03c final AC-roster-behavior (counts WI-03b1's friendly species), WI-03d final AC-roster-count and AC-roster-tests (roster-wide check and spoiler audit); tier-local halves owned per leaf. Handoffs are fresh-session ready: concrete file pointers (src/sim/Simulation.ts, src/sim/scenario.ts, src/world/worldData.ts exist; hiddenCreatures.ts is created by WI-03a, stated in both leaves), request sections, WI-01b organism ids, design_private/ as source of truth, falsifiable assumptions, spoiler-safe commit style, and gating on WI-02a/b/c acceptance.
